readingSelectors.selector: /* 全局阅读字号路由。 所有正式页面、弹窗和工作台只读取同一组 --ws-* 变量。 */ :root, html[data-reading="comfortable"]

/* 大字模式同时提高弱化文字对比度，避免“放大了仍看不清”。 */ html[data-reading="large"] :is(.muted,small,.sc32-title p,.sc32-panel-head p,.sc32-row p,.sc32-service p,.sc32-fact span,.sr32-head p,.sr32-title p,.sr32-card header p,.sr32-toggle small,.sr32-row small,.aiw30-section p,.aiw30-template p,.aiw30-rule p,.contacts-foot,.snippet)
html[data-reading="large"] :is(.sc32-row b,.sc32-service b,.sc32-model-card b,.sr32-toggle b,.sr32-row b,.aiw30-template h4,.aiw30-rule h4)
/* Batch 20: the reading setting is the platform-wide typography authority. */ html[data-reading="standard"]
/* Large text must expand content instead of clipping it. */ html[data-reading="large"] #app :is(.panel,.card,article,section,header,footer,.workspace,.workbench,.grid,.row)
